## Description

Formulates optimal order liquidation in the limit of infinitely many competing market participants using continuous-time mean-field control theory and forward-backward stochastic differential equations (FBSDEs).

## Where it may fit

Institutional block order execution during high market volume congestion, minimizing permanent and transitory impact.

## Vehicles

Agency execution brokers, algorithmic trading desks, institutional asset allocators.

## Required data

Limit order book depth logs, historical execution volume curves, temporary/permanent market impact parameters.

## Caveats

Solving FBSDEs requires deep BSDE solvers or specialized numerical mesh schemes.
